title: aquilegia flabellata f. flavida
intro: Aquilegia flabellata f. flavida, commonly known as the golden fan columbine, is a flowering plant species in the ranunculaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that may help protect against various diseases and infections. The bioactive constituents of Aquilegia flabellata f. flavida include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation, fighting off bacteria and viruses, and exhibiting sedative and anticonvulsant effects. The plant's extracts have been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and skin conditions.
